hooks.name: Run Backend Tests on Change
hooks.description: Runs the scaffolded backend unit and property-test suite after backend Python changes (Kiro University Lesson 3, Hook B).

action.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..'; Set-Location (Join-Path $root 'Namma_Ooru\backend'); python -m pytest tests -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
